headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Total consolidated GAAP revenue across MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise Advanced, and Services.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Consolidated GAAP Revenue ($M): MongoDB posted $771.77M in Q2 FY27 (+30.5% YoY). Management guided Q3 FY27 revenue to $756M–$761M (~20%–21% YoY); Yahoo consensus sits at $761.75M (+21.24% YoY) while buy-side whispers look for $780M–$790M+.

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Non-GAAP diluted earnings per share excluding $148.94M stock-based compensation.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Non-GAAP Diluted EPS ($/sh): Consensus is $1.61/sh (top of Q3 guidance $1.57–$1.61 vs $1.90 in Q2 FY27 and $1.32 in Q3 FY26). MongoDB has beaten consensus EPS 4 consecutive quarters (+26.99% avg surprise).

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Usage-based multi-cloud DBaaS revenue including Atlas Search, Vector Search, and Stream Processing.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: MongoDB Atlas ($M): Reached $565.92M in Q2 FY27 (+28.9% YoY, 73.3% of revenue), adding a record $127M net-new annualized run rate. Management guided Q3 Atlas growth to ~26% YoY (~$592.7M); bulls demand >= 28% YoY (~$602M+).

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Self-managed Enterprise Advanced and other subscription revenue ($181.23M in Q2 FY27).
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Enterprise Advanced & Other ($M): Surged +35.9% YoY to $181.23M in Q2 FY27 (3-year high) on GA rollout of embedded Search & Vector Search for private/multi-cloud deployments.

headline_and_company_kpis.metric: Non-GAAP Operating Margin & Net New Customers
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Non-GAAP operating margin (24.1% in Q2 FY27) and net customer additions (2,900 added in Q2).
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Operating Margin & Customer Scale: Q2 Non-GAAP operating income reached $185.9M (24% margin vs 15% YoY) while total customers topped 70,600 (2,999 >=$100K ARR). Q3 guide implies ~20.5% margin ($152M–$156M).
